# Infoblox outage history — every incident their status page has posted

**36 Infoblox incidents on record** spanning **2025-08-08** to **2026-09-12**. Status page:
[https://status.infoblox.com](https://status.infoblox.com) · platform:
`statuspage` · last polled **2026-09-12 12:30 UTC**, last observed
state **`maintenance`**.

Median incident length: **119 min** across 27 incidents where Infoblox posted both a start and a resolve time.

This page republishes what Infoblox posted on its own status page. It is rebuilt
daily by an automated poller — no login, no account, MIT-licensed data.

## What is counted, and what is not

Of 36 recorded incidents, **27** have a usable length. Excluded:
9 maintenance, 0 still open or missing a timestamp, 0 whose resolution time we inferred rather than read, 0 with a resolve time before the start time. Those exclusions are the reason the numbers here are lower than a naive
count of the status page, and they are why a median from this dataset can be
compared across vendors at all.

"Incidents on record" means incidents this poller has seen or backfilled since
**2026-09-04** — it is not a claim about Infoblox's
entire operating history.
